pages.text: All winter, Gugu collected shiny bits of glass and buttons.
Gugu wanted to lay them by the window and show every single one.
But the window was fogged up. Outside, Nono could not see them.
"Can I see?" Nono asked. Gugu covered the glass with a hand. "No. If you touch it, it will disappear."
Gugu closed the curtains and looked at the collection alone, piece by piece.
It was quiet. No one knocked.
Everything was laid out, but no one was looking. The shiny things seemed dull.
Grandpa Badger asked, "Is it fun all by yourself?"
Gugu opened the curtains wide and called loudly to Nono and Kiki.
Gugu held up each piece for them. "Wow!" The friends opened their eyes wide.
